messages:
alex: Observed sudden perf cliff on 64->65 tokens in main canary (gpu-pool-2). Throughput down ~12%, p50 latency +18%. Flamegraph attached but quick dump: kernel pick flips from fused_attn_small -> generic_attn at 65. Anyone seen this?

maria: Can you paste the profile? which model, quant, hw? :eyes:

alex: model: redwood-7b-q4f, seq len distribution: mostly 1-60, small tail to 256. HW: A10G, compilers: cuBLAS 12.2, runtime autotune commit abc123. Command we used: `./perf/run_trace --model redwood-7b --slen 64 65 --repeat 50 --profile`

rohan: sounds like kernel threshold edgecase. We added a new heuristic that picks fused for <=64, generic >64. Hysteresis was 8 tokens but maybe not applied during batching. Did batching merge a 2-token request causing path flip?

jin: KV cache layout note: prefill path keeps dense KV, decode uses split tiled KV. If pick changes mid-batch KV evict/rehash can spike memory ops. Want the trace.

alex: paste of sample trace:
```
[perf] seq=64 pick = fused_attn_small (lat=1.8ms)
[perf] seq=65 pick = general_attn (lat=2.4ms)
[perf] batch=32 -> kernel change at slot 12
```
Also saw increased L2 thrash.

perf-bot: autotune run #4413 completed. Summary: kernel flip threshold observed at 64; delta throughput -11.7%; kernel generic has 30% higher smem ops; suggestion: re-evaluate heuristic to include batch-size and kv-layout. Link: https://console.redwood/perf/runs/4413 :bar_chart: 

maria: Could we try small hysteresis for bucket transitions in decode path only? Maybe apply sticky pick per-request prefilling stage.

rohan: agree. Also propose fallback: if batch heterogeneity crosses threshold, force both to generic to avoid per-warp divergence. Might cost a little for shortctx but stabilize p50.

jin: I'll run microbench with `batch=1..64` and slen=62..68 on both fused and generic, collect smem counters. If we see consistent mispick, patch autotune to consider batch size and kv-tiling flag.

alex: thanks. Quick nudge: this regressed in canary after autotune commit abc123. Reverting that commit removed cliff. putting PR with toggles.

srebot: Canary flagged unhealthy traffic 2026-03-15T14:03Z, rolling back canary if no fix in 2h. :warning:

maria: I'll add an AB test to surface throughput delta per route.

rohan: if jin needs env, I can repro on gpu-pool-2. ping me.

alex: attaching minimal repro script:
```
for slen in 62 63 64 65 66 67:
  ./bench --model redwood-7b-q4f --slen $slen --batch 32 --iters 200 --dump-kernel
```
Use `REDWOOD_KV_TILE=1` to emulate write path.

jin: started runs. will post CSV + flamegraphs in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
